tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen and the driver console.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows and the Live Activity panel. In the contrast theme it matches surface, so raised things are separated by a `line` border instead.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders and dividers. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on surface, surface-raised and every *-soft tint. At least 14:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (stop codes, distances, timestamps), on surface and surface-raised. At least 8:1 in every theme, so it is still comfortable for low-vision readers.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The StopSignal yellow: the primary action fill and the waiting beacon. Never used as text on light grounds (1.5:1 on surface); always paired with on-signal.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (the main action's label). 11:1 or better.

tokens.name: confirmed
tokens.usage: The confirmed outcome and the hail-sent / hail-moved states. As text on surface, surface-raised or confirmed-soft. Always shown with the circle-tick glyph and the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: confirmed-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panel behind confirmed text or ink text.

tokens.name: on-confirmed
tokens.usage: Text on a solid confirmed fill.

tokens.name: unacknowledged
tokens.usage: The unacknowledged outcome, and the stale and left-stop states, which sound the heads-up. As text on surface, surface-raised or unacknowledged-soft. Always shown with the word and a glyph: the filled triangle for the outcome, the outline triangle for stale, the walking-out arrow for left. Blue and orange are told apart by people with red–green colour blindness [CITE].

tokens.name: unacknowledged-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panel behind unacknowledged text or ink text.

tokens.name: on-unacknowledged
tokens.usage: Text on a solid unacknowledged fill.

tokens.name: cannot-hail
tokens.usage: The cannot-hail outcome, and nothing else. A heavy neutral, not red: it means 'do it yourself', not 'error'. Always shown with the octagon glyph and the word.

tokens.name: cannot-hail-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panel behind cannot-hail text or ink text.

tokens.name: on-cannot-hail
tokens.usage: Text on a solid cannot-hail fill.

tokens.name: withdrawn
tokens.usage: Driver console only: the withdrawal band. Never used in the passenger app, so it cannot be confused with an outcome there.

tokens.name: on-withdrawn
tokens.usage: Text on the withdrawal band. 6:1 or better.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and Switch Control focus ring: 3px solid, offset by a 3px gap in the surface colour, so it shows on a signal fill too.

groups.name: iOS (Dynamic Type, default size)
groups.note: These are Apple's text styles at the default Large setting [CITE]. In SwiftUI use the named style (.largeTitle, .headline …) so they scale with Dynamic Type; never fix a point size.

styles.name: route-number
styles.usage: The route number on Register, Armed and Outcome. Scales with Dynamic Type (relativeTo: .largeTitle).

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The first line of Armed and Outcome: what is happening or what to do.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Stop names in lists, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bus 4 minutes away. Stay at the stop.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Stop codes and distances, in ink-muted. Smallest text in the app.

groups.name: Driver console (web)
groups.note: Fixed sizes: the console is read from arm's length by a tester, not zoomed.

styles.name: console-alert
styles.usage: Withdrawal band heading only. Upper case only here.

styles.name: console-meta
styles.usage: Timestamps and trip ids, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between lines inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the main action; console card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of Armed and Outcome before the first line.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Route chips and small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, panels, the Live Activity.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The main action button.

size.note: Hit areas. WCAG 2.2 asks for 24 × 24; StopSignal uses Apple's 44 [CITE] for everything and a larger main action.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The WCAG 2.2 floor (2.5.8). Nothing interactive is smaller; in practice nothing is below target-standard.

tokens.name: target-standard
tokens.usage: Every secondary control and list row.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the one main action per screen. Full width, sits in the bottom third for one-handed reach.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Border width of buttons and cards in light and dark.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Border width in the contrast theme and on the focus ring.
